title: Master's Degrees, Fall 2027 Admission
about: American University of Sharjah is accepting master's applications for Fall 2027 since October 19, 2026. Applicants seeking a Graduate Assistantship must apply by May 27, 2027; others by July 22, 2027. Classes begin August 23, 2027.
requirements: Four-year bachelor's degree from an accredited institution with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 (on a 4.0 scale)
Graduate Assistantship applicants: tick the assistantship box and submit transcripts and two reference letters by May 27, 2027
Applicants not seeking an assistantship: deadline July 22, 2027
